course.course_title: Tích hợp hệ thống phần mềm

support_context.support_concept_origin: debugging and troubleshooting methodology; interface design principles; interoperability mindset
support_context.evidence_text: Objectives: Equip students with advanced concepts, methods, techniques, and technologies such as XML, XSD, XSLT, JSON, DOM, and Web APIs in software system integration
